caption: The video showcases a yellow plastic multi-blade fish slicer on a wooden tabletop, a silvery fish fillet laid across its open slots. In the background a wooden cutting board holds two more fish pieces, and a dark knife blade enters from the left. Two hands grip the device's ends, thumbs and fingers shifting inward and downward as they adjust their hold on the handles. The upper and lower blade rows remain spaced apart around the fish, which stays a single continuous strip rather than being cut into segments. The right index finger rests along the top-right edge of the tool in the later portion of the clip. The hands-and-slicer assembly tilts and translates a few pixels within the frame while the background board and fish pieces stay fixed. The hands keep holding the open device through the final frame without the blades closing to sever the fillet.
